Show the manual page of slipway or of one of its commands with man(1).
The pages ship with the gem; --install copies them into a man1 directory and says how man(1) finds them.

Examples:
  # Read the page of a command
  slipway man get

  # Install every page for man(1)
  slipway man --install

  # Print the bundled page directory
  slipway man --path

Options:
      --path            Print the directory of the bundled pages and exit.
      --install[=DIR]   Copy every page into DIR, a man1 directory, or into ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/man/man1.

Usage:
  slipway man [COMMAND...] [flags]

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
